title: Disputed evidence
empty.title: No disputed evidence
empty.body: When a learner disputes a result, it appears here until it is reviewed or withdrawn.
privacy.title: The learner's reason stays private
privacy.body: You see which result is disputed, not the learner's explanation. Look at the answer in the learner's enrollment, then uphold or invalidate it. Either decision closes the dispute and is recorded with your name.
truncated: Showing the {count} oldest disputes. Resolve some to see the rest.
saved.invalidated: Evidence invalidated for {learner} on {objective}. The dispute is closed.
saved.upheld: Result upheld for {learner} on {objective}. The dispute is closed.
card.eyebrow: {learner} · {objective} · {days, plural, =0 {opened today} one {open # day} other {open # days}}
card.title: Disputed result for {objective}
card.ownDispute: This is your own dispute. Another staff member must resolve it.
facts.label: Disputed evidence for {learner}
facts.resultValue: {passed, select, yes {passed} other {not passed}}, {independent, select, yes {independent} other {not independent}} (<mode>{mode}</mode>)
decision.uphold: Uphold the result: it stays as recorded
decision.upholdRule: Only an independent, unassisted, passing answer on a checked item can be upheld here.
decision.invalidate: Invalidate this evidence: progress is recomputed without it
note.label: Review note
note.hint: Required. Recorded with the review; an invalidation keeps it as the reason.
